Food regulator FSSAI issues notices for misleading product claims and labels

India's food safety authority, FSSAI, has issued notices to several companies, including Lotte India, Ferns N Petals, and Kubera Foods, for alleged misleading claims and labeling violations. The notices address issues such as misrepresenting product ingredients and making unsubstantiated claims about product composition. This action by FSSAI highlights regulatory scrutiny over food product marketing and consumer information.
